# Finance North

> Educational personal finance guides for Alaskans: Permanent Fund Dividend basics, budgeting for Alaska's cost of living, heating costs, Alaska's tax system and saving for travel. Not financial advice.

All content is general education, not financial, tax or legal advice. The site does not state current-year PFD amounts; readers are directed to the Alaska PFD Division for official figures.

## Pages

- [Home](https://financenorth.org/): Overview of Finance North's Alaska personal finance guides with key facts and FAQs.
- [Alaska Permanent Fund Dividend (PFD): A Plain-Language Guide](https://financenorth.org/permanent-fund-dividend-guide.html): Who qualifies, when to apply, how the amount is decided, how the PFD is taxed and how to put it to good use.
- [How to Budget for Alaska's High Cost of Living](https://financenorth.org/alaska-cost-of-living-budget.html): A step-by-step budget built for Alaska: seasonal income, shipping costs, winter sinking funds and rural realities.
- [Alaska Home Heating Costs: How to Compare Fuels and Cut Your Bill](https://financenorth.org/alaska-heating-costs.html): A simple formula to compare heating oil, gas, propane, wood and electric heat, plus weatherization and assistance programs.
- [Alaska Taxes Explained: What Alaskans Do and Don't Pay](https://financenorth.org/alaska-taxes-explained.html): No state income tax and no statewide sales tax, but local sales, property and excise taxes still matter.
- [Saving for Travel From Alaska: Flights, Funds and Smart Planning](https://financenorth.org/saving-for-travel-alaska.html): Travel sinking funds, booking strategies, rewards basics and an emergency travel plan for remote living.
- [About](https://financenorth.org/about.html): Who runs Finance North, its educational mission, editorial standards and disclaimer.
- [Contact](https://financenorth.org/contact.html): How to reach Finance North by email.
- [Privacy Policy](https://financenorth.org/privacy.html): What data the site collects and how it is used.
